task_instruction: Reconstruct a structured, temporally ordered, evidence-supported attack chain. Select supporting evidence IDs from evidence_cards. Do not invent facts that are not supported.
incident_brief: A web application incident contains repeated admin activity and unusual application, network, and system-call observations. Use only the provided log observation cards to reconstruct what the attacker did, in order, and cite evidence for each step.

attack_chain.step_description: what happened and why it matters
